cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
location_address: 1641 QUIVIRA RD San Diego, CA US 92109
description:
A fun and informal sailboat race series where new sailors can gain valuable experience and grow their sailing network with other Seaforth Members. Everyone is welcome!

We will have a themed race and after party once a month, the LAST Thursday of the month.

- **April 30** -- Regatta Revival (Nautical Chic Opening Night)
Kick off the season in classic sailing style. Breton stripes, captains hats, and dockside glam. Clean, nautical, and festive.
- **May 28** -- Cinco de Sail-o
A tropical twist on a fiesta. Bright colors, fun crew outfits, and a high-energy dock party atmosphere.
- **June 25** -- Retro Regatta (70s / 80s Yacht Rock Night)
Throw it back with vintage yacht rock vibes. Think mustaches, short shorts, retro sunglasses, and classic sailing style.
- **August 27** -- Neon Sail & Glow Party
Bring out the neon and glow gear. Bright colors for the race and a glow party after. This one is always a favorite for photos and energy.
- **September 24** -- Legends of the Bay (Season Finale Party)
Close out the season in style. Dress as a sailing legend, nautical icon, or go full dockside formal. End-of-season celebration and awards.
Think Captain Ron meets Jack Sparrow and hangs out with Popeye!
what_is_included: At the after parties, we will recap the month before and give awards! Seaforth will provide simple snacks every week at after party events, but members are still encouraged to bring food to share (Pot-Luck style). BYOB or can buy at Seaforth Mission Bay.
